description: This file implements a command palette dialog component for the Notesnook application, including search, command execution, and UI rendering logic.

classes.name: CommandPaletteDialog
classes.description: A React component for the command palette dialog, managing search, command selection, and execution.

methods.name: getNextCommandIndex
methods.description: Calculates the next index in the command list for keyboard navigation.

methods.name: getPreviousCommandIndex
methods.description: Calculates the previous index in the command list for keyboard navigation.

methods.name: commandSearch
methods.description: Performs fuzzy search on commands based on user query.

methods.name: useDatabaseFuzzySearch
methods.description: Custom hook to perform fuzzy search on notes, notebooks, tags, and reminders from the database.

methods.name: getSessionsAsCommands
methods.description: Retrieves recent commands and open sessions as command objects.

methods.name: calculateCommandItemLocation
methods.description: Custom scroll positioning logic for command palette items to ensure visibility.

methods.name: getCommandPaletteHelp
methods.description: Provides help key mappings based on command mode.

methods.name: sortCommands
methods.description: Sorts commands by group, with recent commands at the top.
